notes: Budgeted delivery E1, deliver cells: re-import the freeze cell's sessions (embeddings from its cache, synced as .e1-transfer/<benchmark>/), deliver every preregistered variant on the frozen lists through assembleEvidenceForHits at the A1 budgets, and make one live query parity call per question. No reader or judge call; readers replay the frozen contexts on the host.

cells.lease_basis: query embeddings from the freeze cell's cache; one live query per question with the Voyage reranker (about $0.40 per 100 questions), x1.5 and headroom
cells.command: export GBRAIN_EVALS_EMBED_CACHE="$PWD/.e1-transfer/lme-s/embed-cache" && bun eval/runner/memory-qa/run.ts --benchmark lme-s --limit 100 --seed 42 --system gbrain-query --embed real --embedding-model openai:text-embedding-3-large --embedding-dims 1536 --gbrain "$HOME/gbrain-master@{{gbrain_sha}}" --arms docs/benchmarks/2026-10-08-gbrain-budgeted-delivery-e1/manifests/arms/retrieval-only.json --policy-setting stage=deliver --policy-setting b_native={{b_native_lme_s}} --policy-setting b_pseudo={{b_pseudo_lme_s}} --frozen-from .e1-transfer/lme-s/frozen.ndjson --output "$SHOOTOUT_OUT/cell-b"
cells.setup_command: bash eval/systems/bootstrap.sh setup --datasets locomo,beam-100k,lme-s && { test -d "$HOME/gbrain-master/.git" || git clone -q https://github.com/garrytan/gbrain "$HOME/gbrain-master"; } && git -C "$HOME/gbrain-master" fetch -q origin {{gbrain_sha}} && git -C "$HOME/gbrain-master" checkout -q {{gbrain_sha}}
